name: TriMUI Brick
summary: TriMUI's compact 3.2-inch A133P-based handheld with a 1024×768 square IPS display. KNULLI and muOS boot from a prepared SD card while the TrimUI stock OS stays installed on the device; remove the card to boot stock again.
openByDesign: KNULLI and muOS boot from an SD card; the stock OS returns when the card is removed

specs.storage: 8 GB eMMC; TF card expansion up to 1 TB

variants.storage: 8 GB eMMC, TF up to 1 TB
variants.notes: Compact form factor with 3.2-inch full-fit IPS display at 1024×768. Allwinner A133P quad-core Cortex-A53 @1.8 GHz with PowerVR GE8300 GPU. 1 GB LPDDR3 RAM. RGB top atmosphere light bar; L1/L2/R1/R2 function key lights; F1/F2 RGB indicator lights. Single-channel vibration motor. Built-in stereo speaker (0.5W × 2). 3.5 mm headphone jack (bottom). Mono microphone. Battery life 5 hours; USB-C charging at 5V/2A, supports power-off charging. Two USB-C ports: top (USB Host for controller), bottom (charging). Net weight 159 g, dimensions 73.2×109.9×19.9/11.79 mm (two thickness variants). ABS plastic + glass body.

specs.storage: 8 GB eMMC, TF up to 1 TB
specs.audio: 0.5W×2 stereo speaker, 3.5 mm jack (bottom), mono mic

homebrew.name: KNULLI
homebrew.firmware: Per-model image (knulli-a133-trimui-brick); boots from SD card.
homebrew.summary: Retro gaming OS for the TriMUI Brick based on Allwinner A133. Boots from a prepared SD card.

compatibility.note: KNULLI publishes an A133 image for the Brick with Allwinner BSP and pvrsrvkm GL driver.

requirements: A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer.
warnings: KNULLI ships a separate image per model; cross-flashing does not boot.
The firmware includes kernel, bootloader, and u-boot extracted from stock firmware.

homebrew.name: muOS (MustardOS)
homebrew.firmware: Per-model A133 image (muOS 2606.0 Andromeda); written to an SD card with an image writer.
homebrew.summary: Lightweight Linux OS (MustardOS frontend plus RetroArch cores) for the TrimUI Brick. The image is written to an SD card; the stock system is untouched.

compatibility.note: muOS 2606.0 lists the TrimUI Brick (and Brick Pro) on its supported-devices page.

requirements: A TrimUI Brick from muOS's supported-devices page.
An SD card of 16 GB or larger.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer that reads .img.gz files.
warnings: muOS writes a whole-disk image; the target card is erased.

homebrew.name: spruceOS
homebrew.firmware: Frontend on top of the stock OS.
homebrew.summary: Custom Python-based frontend that runs on top of the stock OS on supported TriMUI devices.

compatibility.note: spruceOS lists the TriMUI Brick with 'Stable' support status.

requirements: A new branded microSD card from a reputable source (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: spruceOS is a frontend, not a full OS replacement; it runs on top of the stock OS.
